summary: OPay Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 30, 2026 disclosing that it decided not to complete its previously announced initial public offering and that it and the underwriters mutually agreed to terminate the October 29, 2026 underwriting agreement. The decision followed a regulatory inquiry in a jurisdiction described as immaterial to operations; the company expects a satisfactory near-term resolution. No price, size, or premium terms were stated. The ADSs will not commence trading on the NYSE as scheduled. What to watch: whether the inquiry is resolved and a relaunched offering follows, and any disclosures on costs or timing.
